title: Following US military operation in Venezuela, will 190 countries 'respect any of these rules now'?
summary: The US military operation that led to the seizure of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro has sparked international alarm, both with allies and foes of the United States. For in-depth analysis and a deeper perspective, Genie Godula is pleased to welcome Elvira Dominguez-Redondo, Professor of International Law at Kingston University.
